interfaces.name: pressed
interfaces.meaning: True while the active-low button is pressed
interfaces.hardware: D2 to button, other side GND, internal pullup

interfaces.name: displayNumber
interfaces.hardware: A0 data, A2 shift clock, A1 latch; sr1 tens nearest MCU, sr2 units; common anode; MR=5V, OE=GND

requirements.text: Initially display 00; on each button press increment by 37; if the result exceeds 99 reset to 0. Holding or releasing the button does not increment. Tens on sevseg1, units on sevseg2; update within 20ms.

planning_notes: Static single-digit common-anode displays; Q0..Q6 connect A..G; unused Q7 stays inactive. No multiplexing.
